verdict.rationale: Alloy documents webhook signing: it signs the request body with a shared secret and sends the signature in the Authorization header, so developers can verify authenticity and integrity. It also documents retries with exponential backoff, but nothing in the evidence describes event IDs, idempotency keys or other guidance for deduplicating retried deliveries. That leaves only half the story supported. Missing for 10: documented unique event or delivery identifiers or idempotency guidance for deduplicating retries, signature verification details (algorithm, replay or timestamp protection), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify alert-event authenticity and deduplicate retried notifications
